messages.text: Where is my order? Order # Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Jimmy, I found your order Shop····. It's paid, and nothing has shipped yet. Your B30 and the free Power Kit are both going out from our Canadian warehouse in Ontario, which is waiting on the B30 stock to arrive. Your order ships November 15, and the tracking number will come to you by email as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse on the page you're on: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Before you go, one thing: have you been thinking about adding a second miner alongside the B30, and if so, what's holding you back?
